license_notes: Annotations: GiantSteps project (CC-licensed, github.com/GiantSteps/giantsteps-key-dataset). Audio: Beatport 2-minute preview mp3s (never redistributed from this repo); primary fetch is JKU's backup mirror per the upstream audio_dl.sh v0.3 (2025-03).

sources.name: annotations
sources.notes: annotations/key/<id>.LOFI.key holds literal '<Tonic> <mode>' (e.g. 'C minor'); md5/<id>.LOFI.md5 is both the track list and the per-file audio pin.

sources.name: audio
sources.notes: Refetched previews may legitimately re-encode: an md5 mismatch is recorded as refetched_mismatch and the track still scores (key ground truth is track-level); the count is reported. Kept as mp3 — key scoring is timing-insensitive, so the FLAC transcode policy (which exists for the ±70 ms beat tolerance) does not apply.

notes: scoreable = whatever fetch coverage yields (preview rot is normal); the report prints N of 604.
